t: You're looking at the Church of St Stephen and St Thomas, a Church of England parish church on the south side of Uxbridge Road, on the corner of Coverdale Road, just west of Shepherd's Bush tube station. It was built around 1849 to 1850 in the Gothic Revival style and is Grade II listed. Its architect was Anthony Salvin, who was known as an expert on medieval buildings. He restored the Tower of London and Windsor Castle, and he also built new houses and churches.
